title: Two years on, Valencia is still demanding answers for 234 dead in the 2024 flooding – and blaming Sánchez rather than local Popular Party leaders
lede: Two years on and with 234 dead, the people of Valencia are still waiting for answers as to why, with five days warning, flood alerts were not issued. If the forecasts were known, why did the local government delay a crisis response? And more importantly - who's to blame?
